name: Ashcleaver

attributes.description:
An ember sleeps beneath its dark edge.

Ground Ember: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to kindle an ember under a nearby enemy. Fire pulses after 0.45 and 0.90 seconds share 40% physical attack damage, up to 20 total. Leaving its tile avoids the pulses; your main target is excluded. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
